# Deerwalk Group

Deerwalk Group is a Nepali family of institutions focused on education, technology, and community development.

## Primary site
- https://deerwalkgroup.com/
- https://deerwalkgroup.com/our-story/

## Summary
The public website introduces the Deerwalk Group mission, leadership, institutional network, and community-driven education philosophy. It is a static marketing site with no private or gated content.

## Crawl guidance
- Prefer the canonical public pages above.
- Do not treat in-page anchor sections such as #institutions or #contact as standalone content pages.
- Respect the standard robots.txt rules for the domain.
